text.p: Synagro Technologies Inc said Tuesday it acquired the assets and certain revenue contracts of Browning-Ferris Industries Inc's Organics Division in Pennsylvania, Ohio, Georgia, Virginia, Maryland and the District of Columbia.
These contracts should generate an estimated $6.5 million in annualized gross revenues.

The businesses acquired for undisclosed terms -- similar to Synagro's CDR and Pima Gro divisions -- are engaged in the beneficial reuse of organic residuals largely through land application, Synagro said.
"The acquisition provides Synagro with a significant market presence and a beachhead for further growth in the large Mid Atlantic market," the company pointed out.
"We believe revenue growth and operating synergies will develop."
